module.purpose: Manages transient editor scribbles, including session grouping, point collection, self-consuming trails, persistence, idle stopping, and individual or grouped fade-out.
module.summary: This module provides the editor's scribble lifecycle manager. It maintains sessions containing mutable scribble items, accepts points with distance filtering, supports implicit sessions for simple consumers, and advances rendering state on animation frames. Scribbles can self-consume while active, persist for laser-like behavior, stop after inactivity, and fade individually or as a coordinated group. The manager publishes cloned scribble state through the editor and removes completed sessions.
module.businessContext: Supports editor tools such as eraser, selection feedback, and laser pointers. If lifecycle or fade processing fails, transient visual feedback can become stale, disappear incorrectly, or consume excessive editor state.

typeShapes.name: ScribbleSessionOptions
typeShapes.shape:
{
	/** Session id. Auto-generated if not provided. */
	id?: string
	/**
	 * Whether scribbles self-consume (shrink from start) while drawing.
	 * - true: scribbles eat their own tail as you draw (default, used for eraser/select)
	 * - false: scribbles persist until session stops (used for laser)
	 */
	selfConsume?: boolean
	/**
	 * How long to wait after last activity before auto-stopping the session.
	 * Only applies when selfConsume is false.
	 */
	idleTimeoutMs?: number
	/**
	 * How scribbles fade when stopping.
	 * - 'individual': each scribble fades on its own (default)
	 * - 'grouped': all scribbles fade together as one sequence
	 */
	fadeMode?: 'individual' | 'grouped'
	/**
	 * Easing for grouped fade.
	 */
	fadeEasing?: 'linear' | 'ease-in'
	/**
	 * Duration of the fade in milliseconds.
	 */
	fadeDurationMs?: number
}

typeShapes.name: Session
typeShapes.shape:
{
	id: string
	items: ScribbleItem[]
	state: 'active' | 'stopping' | 'complete'
	options: Required<Omit<ScribbleSessionOptions, 'id'>>
	idleTimeoutHandle?: number
	fadeElapsed: number
	totalPointsAtFadeStart: number
}

preconditions: The supplied session identifier must identify an existing session.

When the session idle timeout is greater than 0, the session idle timeout is reset.

Points closer than distance 1 to the previous point do not replace the item's next point.

A missing scribble in an existing session causes an Error to be thrown.

An item whose previous point is at distance exactly 1 receives the supplied point as its next point.
An item whose previous point is at distance less than 1 does not receive the supplied point as its next point.
A session with idleTimeoutMs equal to 0 does not reset its idle timeout.

units.name: complete

detail.name: complete
preconditions: The session argument may be undefined; when provided, it is expected to be a scribble session with an items collection and state.
postconditions: If a session is provided, its idle timeout is cleared.
If a session is provided, every item in the session has an empty points array.
If a session is provided, its state is set to 'complete'.
If no session is provided, no state or item data is changed.
invariants: All session item points are empty after successful completion.
The completed session state is exactly 'complete'.
edgeCases: When session is undefined, the method returns immediately without clearing timeouts or mutating any session.
When the session contains no items, the session is still marked 'complete' and its idle timeout is cleared.
When the session contains multiple items, points are cleared for every item before the session is marked complete.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: An absent session is treated as a no-op.

stateMutations: Clears the idle timeout associated with the session.
Sets each session item's scribble.points array length to 0.
detail.summary: Completes an active scribble session by cancelling its idle timeout, clearing all item points, and marking the session complete. If no session is supplied, it performs no action.

specLiterals.role: The terminal state assigned to a completed scribble session.

specTests.then: The idle timeout is cleared, both points arrays are emptied, and session.state equals 'complete'.
The method returns without throwing and does not mutate any session state.

detail.name: tickSessionItems
detail.signature: private tickSessionItems(session: ScribbleSession, elapsed: number): void
preconditions: The session argument is a valid ScribbleSession.
elapsed represents the time in milliseconds since the previous animation tick.
postconditions: Each item in the session has been advanced according to its item type and the elapsed duration.
Items that have completed their lifecycle are no longer retained in the session.
invariants: Items are processed as session items without creating unrelated sessions.
The method does not return a value.
edgeCases: An empty session has no items to process and remains without items.
A session containing multiple item types dispatches each item to its corresponding ticking behavior.
Items reaching the end of their lifecycle during the tick are removed rather than retained as active items.
stateMutations: Mutates the scribble items held by the supplied session.
Removes completed scribble items from the supplied session.
detail.summary: Advances every scribble item in a session by the elapsed animation time. Item-specific ticking is delegated according to each item's lifecycle behavior, with completed items removed from the session.

detail.signature: private tickSelfConsumingItem(item: ScribbleItem, elapsed: number): void
preconditions: The item is a session item with a mutable scribble state.
elapsed represents the time since the previous tick.
postconditions: The item's self-consuming animation or lifecycle state is advanced by elapsed time.
The item is marked or reduced appropriately when its consumable content reaches completion.
invariants: The item remains a member of its owning session.
The operation does not produce a return value.
edgeCases: An elapsed value of zero leaves time-based progress unchanged.
An item whose consumable content is already exhausted remains in its terminal state.
A stopping item is processed as a self-consuming item by the session tick flow.
stateMutations: item.scribble lifecycle, consumption, and/or visibility state
detail.summary: Advances a self-consuming scribble item according to the elapsed time, updating the item so it can progressively consume or finish its content.
